stem.text: A device for spraying paint consists of a box with its axes horizontal and vertical. One of its vertical faces contains small holes. Paint is fed into the box under pressure via a vertical tube and exits through the holes as fine streams moving horizontally.

stem.alt: Pictorial diagram of a rectangular box with a vertical tube entering its top and a vertical face with rows of small holes. Labels: paint in (arrow into the tube); paint out through holes (only a few holes are shown).

stem.text: The paint is ejected at a speed of $2.5\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ through 400 holes, each of area $0.4\,\text{mm}^{2}$. The density of the paint is $900\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$.
What is the horizontal force required to hold the device stationary as it ejects the paint?
